receipts.provenance: Coordinator downloaded official resource; completion time from file mtime

limitations: Most PLATEAU buildings are LoD1; no invented roof form; roof colour only from aerial centroid, not corrected roof textures.
LAS DSM covers only measured cells: see coverage PNG and lidar.npz. GSI DTM is NOT DSM.

Measured canopy uses DSM-DTM supported by aerial/OSM woodland, with PLATEAU roofs+2m excluded. LAS classes alone miss tall canopy. Estimated tree heights outside LAS coverage are nominal 8 m; crown radius is inferred.
Terrain resampled to 1 m textures / 10 m geometry from coarser GSI DEM; no extra accuracy implied.
Absolute source elevations retained, no vertical epoch/geoid adjustment. Source boundary/roof/terrain mismatch remains possible.
Road widths without width tags are cartographic estimates. Bridges shown at bare-earth level; animated traffic excludes bridges and tunnels.
Animated vehicles/birds, building windows and night lights are decorative, not live observations.
Upstream repository has no formal LICENSE file; README invites adaptation/publication. Original authorship retained, no broad relicensing.

terrain.vertical_reference: Tokyo Bay mean sea level; no epoch/geoid adjustment
terrain.dsm: max valid LAS return; gaps NaN
terrain.vegetation: LAS classes 3/4/5 retained for audit; incomplete tall canopy. Main trees use measured DSM-DTM plus aerial/OSM support and PLATEAU roof exclusion

building.height_provenance: actual CityGML polygon elevations; measuredHeight retained separately; no synthetic extrusion

tree.method: Measured DSM-DTM, aerial green or OSM woodland support, PLATEAU projected footprint plus 2m margin excluded; LAS vegetation classes audit only
tree.limitations: Source classification misses tall canopy. Crown radius inferred from measured height; no individual-tree species inventory. Conservative building exclusion also omits rooftop gardens. DSM gaps remain NaN.
